Dear Orac team,

I'm applying for the Webmaster Ad Interim role in Ostend. Your need for someone to take immediate ownership of oracdecor.com matches how I work: hands-on, independent, and focused on keeping a site technically healthy and content accurate.

cover_letter:
Dear Orac team,

I'm writing to apply for the Webmaster Ad Interim position at your Ostend HQ. Your need for someone to step in quickly and keep oracdecor.com running smoothly matches the way I work: hands-on, independent, and focused on technical health, content accuracy, and user experience.

In my current freelance practice and my role as a junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage websites end to end. I build and update pages in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), implement on-page SEO and structured data, and keep content and product data current across multiple sites. For a pharmacists' association, I'm building and maintaining a site with a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages—work that demands attention to detail and reliable publishing. I also run technical SEO audits, monitor performance with Google Analytics and Search Console, and use Semrush and Ahrefs to spot issues and improve workflows.

I'm used to coordinating with marketing teams and clients on priorities and deadlines, and I work comfortably in Jira to keep tickets, status updates, and blockers visible. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and my daily use of AI tools and Python automation help me troubleshoot quickly and reduce repetitive work.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, available for a hybrid assignment in Ostend, and ready to take ownership from day one. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your digital marketing team during this interim period.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
